Name: Witch's Broom Horse Replacement
Author: voltaek
Description:
This mod changes your horse to look like the witch's broom. It's fully animated when moving, idle, and eating a carrot, just like a horse. You can ride it around at the same speed as your horse, it will eat carrots like your horse, and it can even still wear hats.

The farmer's sprite has also had minor tweaks to it so you hold onto the broom handle instead of horse reins.

[size=4]Compatibility[/size]
Stardew Valley v1.6

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13428]Change Horse Sounds[/url] - A solution for horse footstep sound replacement. Configured to mute horse sounds by default.
